# UDreamUILayoutLibrary

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from `UBlueprintFunctionLibrary`.

Declared in `Public/DreamUILayoutLibrary.h`.

The viewport, the mouse and the screen -- this framework's UWidgetLayoutLibrary.

Everything here was reachable from C++ and from nowhere else: the viewport's size, its DPI scale,
the mouse position in the coordinates the UI actually uses, and where a world location lands on
screen. A Blueprint wanting to pin a marker to an enemy had to go through the UMG library, whose
answers are in Slate's spaces and not this framework's, and hope the two agreed.

## Functions

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bool GetMousePositionOnPlatform(FVector2D& OutMousePosition)` | pure | The mouse in the PLATFORM's coordinates -- desktop pixels, across every monitor. |
| `bool GetMousePositionOnViewport(UObject* WorldContextObject, FVector2D& OutMousePosition)` | pure | The mouse in viewport pixels, top-left zero. |
| `bool GetMousePositionScaledByDPI(APlayerController* InPlayer, FVector2D& OutMousePosition)` | pure | The mouse in DPI-scaled viewport coordinates -- the space the UI is laid out in. |
| `FDreamUIWidgetGeometry GetPlayerScreenWidgetGeometry(UObject* WorldContextObject, APlayerController* InPlayer)` | pure | The geometry of the whole screen for a player -- UMG's GetViewportWidgetGeometry and GetPlayerScreenWidgetGeometry, which are one function here because there is one screen root per local player and no shared layer behind them. |
| `float GetViewportScale(UObject* WorldContextObject)` | pure | The project's DPI scale for the current viewport size -- the number the whole UI is scaled by before it is shown. The same curve UMG reads, so a project that tuned it once is obeyed here. |
| `FVector2D GetViewportSize(UObject* WorldContextObject)` | pure | The game viewport's size in pixels. Zero when there is no viewport, e.g. on a dedicated server. |
| `bool ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPosition(APlayerController* InPlayer, FVector InWorldLocation, FVector2D& OutScreenPosition, bool bPlayerViewportRelative)` | pure | Where a world location lands on screen, in viewport pixels -- what a health bar over an enemy needs. False when the location is behind the camera or there is no viewport. |
| `bool ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPositionWithDistance(APlayerController* InPlayer, FVector InWorldLocation, FVector2D& OutScreenPosition, float& OutDistance, bool bPlayerViewportRelative)` | pure | The same, and how far away it was. The distance is what a marker fades or sorts by. |
| `void RemoveAllWidgets(UObject* WorldContextObject)` | callable | Take every tracked page off the screen. UMG's RemoveAllWidgets. |
| `UDreamPanelSlot* SlotAsPanelSlot(UDreamWidget* InWidget)` | pure | A widget's panel slot -- UMG's whole SlotAs* family in one node. |

## Compared with UMG

Every Blueprint-facing member of the UMG class, and where it went. *adopt*: same name, same meaning. *map*: here under another name or on another type. *reject*: deliberately absent, with the reason.

| UMG | Member | Status | Here | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPosition` | adopt | `ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPosition` | Returns bool and writes the position out, so a location behind the camera is reported rather than answered with a plausible number. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPositionWithDistance` | adopt | `ProjectWorldLocationToWidgetPositionWithDistance` | Distance is a separate float rather than UMG's Z component of an FVector, and it is SIGNED along the view direction so a location behind the camera does not report the same depth as its mirror image in front. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetViewportScale` | adopt | `GetViewportScale` | Reads the project's own UUserInterfaceSettings DPI curve, the same one UMG reads, so a project that tuned it once is obeyed by both. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetViewportSize` | adopt | `GetViewportSize` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetViewportWidgetGeometry` | map | `GetPlayerScreenWidgetGeometry` | One function, because there is one screen root PER LOCAL PLAYER and no shared layer behind them -- the distinction UMG draws between AddToViewport and AddToPlayerScreen does not exist here. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetPlayerScreenWidgetGeometry` | adopt | `GetPlayerScreenWidgetGeometry` | Reads the screen root without creating one: asking about a geometry must not bring a screen into existence. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetMousePositionOnPlatform` | adopt | `GetMousePositionOnPlatform` | False when Slate is not running, so a headless caller can tell 'no cursor' from 'cursor at the origin'. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetMousePositionOnViewport` | adopt | `GetMousePositionOnViewport` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetMousePositionScaledByDPI` | adopt | `GetMousePositionScaledByDPI` | Returns an FVector2D rather than UMG's two floats. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsBorderSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` | One UDreamPanelSlot class whatever the parent is, so the whole SlotAs* family collapses to one node and there is nothing to pick wrong. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsCanvasSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsGridSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsHorizontalBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsOverlaySlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsUniformGridSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsVerticalBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsScrollBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsSafeBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsScaleBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsSizeBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsStackBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsWrapBoxSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `SlotAsWidgetSwitcherSlot` | map | `SlotAsPanelSlot` |  |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `RemoveAllWidgets` | adopt | `RemoveAllWidgets` | Takes every tracked page off the screen through UDreamScreenUISubsystem. |
| `UWidgetLayoutLibrary` | `GetDesignTimeInfo` | map | `UDreamUserWidget::IsDesignTime` | UMG's struct carries the designer's preview size and flags. The only part of it that means anything at runtime here is 'am I in the designer', which is what a graph uses it for. |
